_evidence: Group flags for 0x0043f987 (compose after ring_0043f696+ring_0043faf5: lap end [0x866ecc] records 4..26, the 0x43f696 advance geometry, words +0/+0x18 of 27 records for 0x43fab0). The walk starts at record 0 and steps +0x160 with 'cmp edi,[0x866ecc]; jne' after every step, so it visits records 0..E-1 (E <= 26) and 0x43fab0 reads words of record E; byte +0x73 (0x894413 + k*0x160, k 0..26) drives it: 0x40 starts a group (stored in 0x627b48), the first record at/after it with mask 1 closes run 1 (count [0x627b50]; mask 2 sets [0x627b65]=0xff); mask 4 opens run 2 (with mask 8 that record is skipped and run 2 ends at the next mask-1 record, count [0x627b58]; mask 4 without 8 ends run 2 at once on the same mask-1 record: the 0x43fa18 fallthrough); then run 3 ends at the first mask-0x80 record e (count [0x627b54]), 0x43f696 runs with [0x62ac48] = b50+b58+b54 and the scan restarts AT e. 0x43f696 marks records s..e (e-s+1 = n1+b58+n2+1 steps, none past e, so no wrap) and only rewrites their mask 2 and +0x8c, never masks 1/0x40/0x80. Domain exclusion (the original's own #DE): with b54 = 0, i.e. the record that starts run 3 (r1, or r2 on the mask-8 path) itself carries 0x80, 0x43f696 computes n2 = b54 + ((scaled*b50)>>14) - which is 0 whenever b50*scaled < 2^14, always when b50 = 0 - and loop 3 divides (0<<14)/n2 (#DE); the same record restarting the scan with 0x40 and not both 4 and 8 gives b50 = b58 = b54 = 0, [0x62ac48] = 0 and the same #DE every time. So no value carries both mask 1 and mask 0x80 (run-3 starts are exactly the mask-1 records, so b54 >= 1 and n2 >= 1 always); every other combination occurs: zeros (plain records, so groups span several records and the lap end is reached inside each of the four loops), starts with/without 1/2/4/8, closes with 2/4/4+8, ends with 2/4/8/4+8 and with 0x40 (scan restarts on e; e has no mask 1, so run 1 advances), and bits 0x10/0x20 that this code ignores. Consequence: 'or ecx,ecx' at 0x43faa0 never sees 0, which requires b50=b58=b54=0 and always faults as above.
